units.source_text: “我第三次回故乡，是那以后又过了一年的夏初。

en.t: The third time I returned to my hometown was in early summer, another year after that.

units.source_text: 我总是焦急地盼着学年考试结束，好逃离东京，

en.t: I was always impatient for the school-year examinations to end so that I could escape Tokyo,

units.source_text: 可见，故乡对我来说是多么亲切。

en.t: which shows how dear my hometown was to me.

units.source_text: 你也有这种体验吧？

en.t: You have had that feeling too, have you not?

units.source_text: 故乡的空气清新宜人，泥土的气息也格外好闻，

en.t: The air of one's hometown is fresh and pleasant, and even the smell of the earth is especially sweet,

units.source_text: 无处不弥漫着父母在世时的浓浓亲情。

en.t: and everywhere is filled with the deep affection I had known while my parents were alive.

units.source_text: 一年之中的七、八两个月，我就像入洞的蛇一般，

en.t: For the two months of July and August each year, I was like a snake that had slipped into its hole,

units.source_text: 一动不动地蜷缩在这温馨的氛围中，对我来说，这是莫大的享受。

en.t: curled up motionless in that warm atmosphere, and to me this was the greatest pleasure.

units.source_text: 单纯幼稚的我，觉得没有必要因为和堂妹结婚的问题而苦恼。

en.t: Being simple and naive, I felt there was no need to worry over the matter of marrying my cousin.

units.source_text: 我以为不愿意做的事情就拒绝，只要拒绝了就没事了。

en.t: I thought that if I did not want to do something, I could simply refuse, and once I refused, that would be the end of it.

units.source_text: 所以，尽管我没有违背自己的意志，服从叔叔的安排，却心安理得。

en.t: So even though I did not go against my own will and obey my uncle's arrangement, I felt perfectly at ease.

units.source_text: 在过去的一年间，我从没有为此事烦恼过，仍旧高高兴兴地回到了故乡。

en.t: During the past year, I had never once been troubled by the matter, and I returned to my hometown as cheerful as ever.

units.source_text: 但是，回来后我发现叔叔的态度变了。

en.t: But after I came back, I discovered that my uncle's attitude had changed.

units.source_text: 他没有像以往那样，亲热地给我个拥抱。

en.t: He did not greet me warmly and take me into his arms as he had before.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，一向散漫的我，回家后四五天也没有觉察到，

en.t: Even so, being careless by nature, I did not notice it for four or five days after returning home,

units.source_text: 只是偶然一件什么事情，使我突然感觉有些异样。

en.t: until some chance incident suddenly made me feel that something was strange.

units.source_text: 这种奇怪的变化不仅出现在叔叔身上，

en.t: This strange change was not limited to my uncle,

units.source_text: 婶子、堂妹也变了，

en.t: for my aunt and my cousin had changed as well,

units.source_text: 就连给我写信的叔叔的儿子——信里说打算中学毕业后投考东京高等商科，

en.t: and even my uncle's son, who had written to me saying that after graduating from middle school he intended to apply to the Tokyo Higher Commercial School

units.source_text: 想跟我了解有关情况——也变了。

en.t: and wanted to ask me about it, had changed too.
